sets.componentsNote: Composition is the D1 record: product_set_items (live D1), sets 1/2/3 map to SUR-SET-001/002/003, all qty=1, in sort_order (seed 28-product_set_items-1.sql, 60 rows). TC 24 swaps exactly three pieces for their tungsten-carbide counterparts named in the SUR-SET-002 description (025->027 Cottle TC Scissors, 035->036 Famon Raspa TC, 070->071 Maltz Scraper TC); the Alp Raspa TC (005) is a component of both the Standard and TC sets. All components have no public sales price in D1, so every variant is Price on request (bundle rule: sum of component sales prices less 5%).
sets.source: Live D1 product_sets + product_set_items, queried 2026-11-06 (60 rows, counts 24/24/12 match piece_count). All three sets have price_cents null (Price on request).
